name: secrets-management-design
description: Design secrets management: vault selection (Vault / AWS Secrets Manager / GCP Secret Manager / Azure Key Vault / Doppler / 1Password), secret lifecycle (generation / distribution / rotation / revocation), access control (per-service / per-env), injection pattern (env var / file / sidecar / API fetch), audit, CI/CD integration, break-glass procedure. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
